# Generate Within Set Covariance
```{r}
power_law_sigma <- function(c = 1, a = -1, p) {
  i <- seq_len(p)
  c * (i ^ a)
}

generate_within_set_cov <- function(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = -1, a_y = -1, p_x, p_y) {
  Sigma_x <- power_law_sigma(c_x, a_x, p_x) # Vector
  Sigma_y <- power_law_sigma(c_y, a_y, p_y)
  list(Sigma_x = Sigma_x, Sigma_y = Sigma_y)
}
```

# Generate Orthonormal U and V
```{r}
generate_UV_qr <- function(p_x, p_y, k) {
  
  U_k <- qr.Q(qr(matrix(rnorm(p_x * k), nrow = p_x, ncol = k)), complete = FALSE)
  V_k <- qr.Q(qr(matrix(rnorm(p_y * k), nrow = p_y, ncol = k)), complete = FALSE)
  
  list(U_k = U_k, V_k = V_k)
}
```

# Compute Weights from U and V
```{r}
compute_W_from_UV <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V) {
  
  W_X <- diag(1 / sqrt(Sigma_x)) %*% U
  W_Y <- diag(1 / sqrt(Sigma_y)) %*% V
  
  list(W_X = W_X, W_Y = W_Y)
}
```

# Generate Between Set 
```{r}
compute_Sigma_XY_from_UVS <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V, r_true, k) {
  
  if (k == 1) {
    S <- matrix(r_true, nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
  } else {
    S <- diag(r_true, nrow = k)
  }
  
  Sigma_XY <- diag(sqrt(Sigma_x)) %*% U %*% S %*% t(V) %*% diag(sqrt(Sigma_y))
  
  return(Sigma_XY)
}
```

# Assemble Joint Cov
```{r}
assemble_joint_cov <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, Sigma_XY) {
  
  Sigma_X <- diag(Sigma_x)
  Sigma_Y <- diag(Sigma_y)
  
  Sigma <- rbind(
    cbind(Sigma_X, Sigma_XY),
    cbind(t(Sigma_XY), Sigma_Y)
  )
  
  return(Sigma)
}
```

# Combined Simulator
```{r}
generate_cca_population <- function(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = -1, a_y = -1,
                               p_x, p_y, r_true) {
  
  r_true <- as.numeric(r_true)
  k <- length(r_true)
  
  # Within set covariances
  covs <- generate_within_set_cov(c_x, c_y, a_x, a_y, p_x, p_y)
  Sigma_x <- covs$Sigma_x
  Sigma_y <- covs$Sigma_y
  
  uv <- generate_UV_qr(p_x, p_y, k)
  U <- uv$U_k
  V <- uv$V_k
  
  W <- compute_W_from_UV(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V)
  W_X <- W$W_X
  W_Y <- W$W_Y
  
  # Between set covariance
  Sigma_XY <- compute_Sigma_XY_from_UVS(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V, r_true, k)
    
  # Joint covariance
  Sigma <- assemble_joint_cov(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, Sigma_XY)
  
  list(
    W_X = W_X,
    W_Y = W_Y,
    p_x = p_x,
    p_y = p_y,
    r_true = r_true,
    joint_cov = Sigma
  )
}
```

# Generate Joint Data
```{r}
generate_joint_data <- function(joint_cov, n, p_x) {
  p_total <- ncol(joint_cov)
  
  Z <- MASS::mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, p_total), Sigma = joint_cov)
  
  list(
    X = Z[, 1:p_x],
    Y = Z[, (p_x + 1):p_total]
  )
}
```

# Power
```{r}
compute_power <- function(joint_cov , p_x, n = 100, 
                          num_datasets = 100, 
                          num_permutations = 100,
                          alpha = 0.05, k) {
  
  # num_datasets x k 
  success_bonf <- matrix(0, nrow = num_datasets, ncol = k)

  for (d in 1:num_datasets) {
    
    # Generate datasets 
    data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
    
    r_obs_all <- cancor(data$X, data$Y)$cor[1:k]
    
    # k x num_perm
    r_null_matrix <- replicate(num_permutations, {
      Y_perm <- data$Y[sample.int(n), , drop = FALSE]
      cancor(data$X, Y_perm)$cor[1:k]
    })

    # Calculate p values
    # Computes the number of times the the r_null corr is >= to the corr_obs / num_perm + 1
    for (j in 1:k) {
      p_val_j <- (sum(r_null_matrix[j, ] >= r_obs_all[j]) + 1) / (num_permutations + 1)
      
      if (p_val_j < alpha / k) success_bonf[d, j] <- 1
    }
  }
  
  return(colMeans(success_bonf))
  
}
```

```{r}
compute_power_1d <- function(joint_cov, p_x, n = 100, 
                             num_datasets = 100, 
                             num_permutations = 100,
                             alpha = 0.05, method) {
  
  success <- numeric(num_datasets)
  
  for (d in 1:num_datasets) {
    
    # Generate dataset
    data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
    
    # Observed canonical correlation (scalar)
    r_obs <- cancor(data$X, data$Y)$cor[1]
    
    # Null distribution (vector)
    r_null <- replicate(num_permutations, {
      Y_perm <- data$Y[sample.int(n), , drop = FALSE]
      cancor(data$X, Y_perm)$cor[1]
    })
    
    # Permutation p-value
    p_val <- (sum(r_null >= r_obs) + 1) / (num_permutations + 1)
    
    # Bonferroni not needed (k = 1)
    if (p_val < alpha) success[d] <- 1
  }
  
  mean(success)
}
```

# Solve CCA
```{r}
solve_cca_dataset <- function(joint_cov, n = 100, p_x, k) {
  
  # Generate data
  data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
  X <- data$X
  Y <- data$Y
  
  # Compute CCA using cancor
  cca_res <- cancor(X, Y)
  
  # Canonical weights
  WX_hat_k <- cca_res$xcoef[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  WY_hat_k <- cca_res$ycoef[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Canonical correlations
  r_obs_all <- cca_res$cor[1:k]
  
  # Canonical scores
  scores_X <- scale(X, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% WX_hat_k
  scores_Y <- scale(Y, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% WY_hat_k
  
  list(
    WX_hat = WX_hat_k,
    WY_hat = WY_hat_k,
    r_obs = r_obs_all,
    scores_X = scores_X,
    scores_Y = scores_Y,
    joint_cov = joint_cov,
    p_x = p_x,
    n = n 
  )
}
```

# Relative Correlation Error
```{r}
relative_error <- function(r_est, r_true) {
  
  (r_est - r_true) / r_true
}
```

# Cossim Similarity
```{r}
cos_similarity_k <- function(W_hat, W_true) {
  
  # Calculates cossim similarity for 2 weight matrices
  
  norm_hat <- sqrt(colSums(W_hat^2)) # Vector
  norm_true <- sqrt(colSums(W_true^2))
  
  # Element wise multiplication and summing over cols
  dot_products <- colSums(W_hat * W_true)

  cos_theta <- dot_products / (norm_hat * norm_true) # Vector
  
  pmin(pmax(cos_theta, -1), 1)
}
```

# Weight Error
```{r}
weight_error_k <- function(WX_hat, WY_hat, WX_true, WY_true) {
  
  # Compute 1 - |cos| for each dimension
  err_X <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(WX_hat, WX_true))
  err_Y <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(WY_hat, WY_true))
  
  # Parallel max
  pmax(err_X, err_Y)
}
```

# Score and Loading Error
```{r}
center_cols <- function(M) sweep(M, 2, colMeans(M), "-")
```

```{r}
score_loading_error_k <- function(cca_fit, WX_true, WY_true, method) {

  # Generate test data
  test_data <- generate_joint_data(cca_fit$joint_cov, cca_fit$n, cca_fit$p_x)
  
  # Compute scores
  sX_hat  <- test_data$X %*% cca_fit$WX_hat # n x k
  sX_true <- test_data$X %*% WX_true
  sY_hat  <- test_data$Y %*% cca_fit$WY_hat
  sY_true <- test_data$Y %*% WY_true
  
  # Column center
  sX_hat  <- center_cols(sX_hat)
  sX_true <- center_cols(sX_true)
  sY_hat  <- center_cols(sY_hat)
  sY_true <- center_cols(sY_true)
  
  # Score error
  err_score_X <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(sX_hat, sX_true))
  err_score_Y <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(sY_hat, sY_true))
  score_err   <- pmax(err_score_X, err_score_Y)
  
  # Compute loading error
  compute_load_err <- function(X, s_hat, s_true) {
    est_load  <- cor(X, s_hat) # p x k
    true_load <- cor(X, s_true)
    
    est_load  <- center_cols(est_load)
    true_load <- center_cols(true_load)
    
    1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(est_load, true_load))
  }
  
  loading_err <- pmax(
    compute_load_err(test_data$X, sX_hat, sX_true),
    compute_load_err(test_data$Y, sY_hat, sY_true)
  )
  
  list(score = score_err, loading = loading_err)
}
```

# Figure 1
```{r}
# Parameters
p_x <- 8; p_y <- 8
r_true_list <- list(
  "blue"  = c(0.55, 0.5, 0.45),  # Med
  "green" = c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15)  # Low
)
n_per_ftr <- c(3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000) 
n_reps_datasets <- 100 
n_reps_models <- 10
k_comp <- 3 # Num of canonical pairs

if(!dir.exists("cca_sim_results")) dir.create("cca_sim_results")

# Simulation
for (r_color in names(r_true_list)) {
  r_val <- r_true_list[[r_color]] # Get the correlation vector corresponding to r_color
  message("\n--- Simulation for r_true [", r_color, "] = ", paste(r_val, collapse = ","), " ---")
  
  for (m in 1:n_reps_models) {
    model_filename <- paste0("cca_sim_results/res_r", r_color, "_mod", m, ".rds")
    
    # Generate population model
    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = p_x, p_y = p_y, r_true = r_val)
    joint_cov <- model$joint_cov
    wX_true <- model$W_X
    wY_true <- model$W_Y
    
    # Empty list to store metrics for all npf
    model_results <- list()
    
    for (npf in n_per_ftr) {
      current_n <- npf * p_x
      
      # Power
      if (npf > 256) {
        pow_res <- rep(1.0, k_comp)
      } else {
        pow_res <- compute_power(joint_cov, p_x = p_x, n = current_n,
                                 num_datasets = n_reps_datasets, num_permutations = 100, k = k_comp)
      }
      
      # Results of computing metrics 100 times
      iter_metrics <- replicate(n_reps_datasets, {
        res <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov, n = current_n, p_x = p_x, k = k_comp)
        
        w_err <- weight_error_k(res$WX_hat, res$WY_hat, wX_true, wY_true)
        s_l_err <- score_loading_error_k(res, wX_true, wY_true)
        
        list(assoc = res$r_obs, w_err = w_err, s_err = s_l_err$score, l_err = s_l_err$loading)
      }, simplify = FALSE) # Keep as list of lists
      
      # For each canonical pair take metric average and save results
      for (comp in 1:k_comp) {
        avg_assoc <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$assoc[comp]))
        avg_werr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$w_err[comp]))
        avg_serr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$s_err[comp]))
        avg_lerr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$l_err[comp]))
        
        model_results[[length(model_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          color = r_color,
          r_true_val = r_val[comp],
          component = comp,
          n_per_ftr = npf,
          model_id = m,
          Power = pow_res[comp],
          Association = avg_assoc,
          Weight_Error = avg_werr,
          Score_Error = avg_serr,
          Loading_Error = avg_lerr
        )
      }
    }
    saveRDS(bind_rows(model_results), model_filename)
    message("Saved Model ", m, " for ", r_color)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load and Prepare Data ---
files <- list.files("cca_sim_results", full.names = TRUE)
df_final <- map_dfr(files, readRDS)

df_plot <- df_final %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Power, Association, Weight_Error, Score_Error, Loading_Error),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, 
                         levels = c("Power", "Association", "Weight_Error", "Score_Error", "Loading_Error")))

# --- 2. Fixed Panel Generator Function ---
make_panel <- function(comp_idx, metric_name, show_y_axis = FALSE, panel_label = "") {
  
  sub_df <- df_plot %>% filter(component == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  
  # Identify true values for the legend
  r_blue  <- sub_df %>% filter(color == "blue") %>% pull(r_true_val) %>% first()
  r_green <- sub_df %>% filter(color == "green") %>% pull(r_true_val) %>% first()
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value, color = color, fill = color)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1), geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")) +
    # FIXED: Ticks every 100 up to 1000
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(250, 500, 750, 1000)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = -0.05, vjust = -1, size = 14, face = "plain")) +
    labs(title = panel_label)
  
  # Association Row: Dashed lines and "true" labels
  if (metric_name == "Association") {
    p <- p + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = r_blue, color = "#0000CD", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = r_green, color = "#00FF7F", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 60, y = r_blue - 0.04, label = "true", color = "#0000CD", size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 60, y = r_green - 0.04, label = "true", color = "#00FF7F", size = 3.5) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.8))
  }
  
  # Power Row: FIXED LEGEND POSITIONing for the 1000 scale
  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    # Moved x to ~800 to sit in the white space of the converged lines
    p <- p + 
      annotate("text", x = 750, y = 0.42, label = "italic(r)[true] == phantom(0)", parse = TRUE, size = 4.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 850, y = 0.35, label = sprintf("%.2f", r_blue), color = "#0000CD", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
      annotate("text", x = 850, y = 0.18, label = sprintf("%.2f", r_green), color = "#00FF7F", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02))
  }
  
  # Error Rows: Standardized Y-limits
  if (metric_name %in% c("Weight_Error", "Score_Error", "Loading_Error")) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02))
  }
  
  # Hide Y axis for components 2 and 3
  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 3. Building the Layout ---
create_row_label <- function(text) {
  wrap_elements(panel = textGrob(text, rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)))
}

# --- Column Labels ---
col_labels <- lapply(c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"), function(lbl) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = lbl, size = 5) +
    theme_void()
})

# --- Row labels ---
row_labels <- create_row_label("Power") / 
              create_row_label("Association strength") / 
              create_row_label("Weight error") / 
              create_row_label("Score error") / 
              create_row_label("Loading error")

col1 <- (make_panel(1, "Power", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Association", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Weight_Error", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Score_Error", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Loading_Error", T))

# Construct Column 2
col2 <- (make_panel(2, "Power", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Association", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Weight_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Score_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Loading_Error", F))

# Construct Column 3
col3 <- (make_panel(3, "Power", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Association", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Weight_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Score_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Loading_Error", F))

row_labels <- wrap_elements(
  create_row_label("Power") / 
  create_row_label("Association strength") / 
  create_row_label("Weight error") / 
  create_row_label("Score error") / 
  create_row_label("Loading error")
)

final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  # Top row
  plot_spacer(), col_labels[[1]], col_labels[[2]], col_labels[[3]],
  # Bottom row
  row_labels, col1, col2, col3,
  ncol = 4,
  heights = c(0.015, 1),  # smaller top row
  widths = c(0.16, 1, 1, 1)
) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Samples per feature",
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
  )

# --- 4. Export ---
ggsave("Fig1_3D.pdf", final_plot, width = 10, height = 14)
```

```{r}
# Parameters
p_x <- 8; p_y <- 8

for (r_color in names(r_true_list)) {

  message("\n--- Simulation for r_true [", r_color, "] = ", paste(r_val, collapse = ","), " ---")
  
  for (m in 1:n_reps_models) {
    model_filename <- paste0("cca_sim_results_1d/res_r", r_color, "_mod", m, ".rds")
    
    # Generate population model
    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = p_x, p_y = p_y, r_true = r_val)
    joint_cov <- model$joint_cov
    wX_true <- model$W_X
    wY_true <- model$W_Y
    
    # Empty list to store metrics for all npf
    model_results <- list()
    
    for (npf in n_per_ftr) {
      current_n <- npf * p_x
      
      # Power
      pow_res <- compute_power_1d(joint_cov, p_x = p_x, n = current_n, 
                                  num_datasets = n_reps_datasets, num_permutations = 100)
      
      # Results of computing metrics 100 times
      iter_metrics <- replicate(n_reps_datasets, {
        res <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov, n = current_n, p_x = p_x, k = k_comp)
        
        w_err <- weight_error_k(res$WX_hat, res$WY_hat, wX_true, wY_true)
        s_l_err <- score_loading_error_k(res, wX_true, wY_true)
        
        list(assoc = res$r_obs, w_err = w_err, s_err = s_l_err$score, l_err = s_l_err$loading)
      }, simplify = FALSE) # Keep as list of lists
      
      avg_assoc <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$assoc[1]))
      avg_werr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$w_err[1]))
      avg_serr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$s_err[1]))
      avg_lerr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$l_err[1]))
        
      model_results[[length(model_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        color = r_color,
        r_true_val = r_val[1],
        component = 1,
        n_per_ftr = npf,
        model_id = m,
        Power = pow_res,
        Association = avg_assoc,
        Weight_Error = avg_werr,
        Score_Error = avg_serr,
        Loading_Error = avg_lerr
      )
    }
    saveRDS(bind_rows(model_results), model_filename)
    message("Saved Model ", m, " for ", r_color)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load Data ---
full_df <- list.files("cca_sim_results_1d", pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  map_df(readRDS)

# --- 2. Process Data ---
plot_df <- full_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Power, Association, Weight_Error, Score_Error, Loading_Error), 
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(color, r_true_val, n_per_ftr, Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_v = mean(Value, na.rm=TRUE),
    low_v = quantile(Value, 0.025, na.rm=TRUE),
    high_v = quantile(Value, 0.975, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# --- 3. Plot Function ---
make_p <- function(metric_name, title_y, show_x = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE) {
  paper_colors <- c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")
  paper_labels <- c("blue" = "0.5", "green" = "0.1")  # <-- legend labels
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df %>% filter(Metric == metric_name), 
              aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = mean_v, color = color, fill = color)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low_v, ymax = high_v), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = paper_colors, labels = paper_labels, name = expression(r[true])) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = paper_colors, labels = paper_labels, name = expression(r[true])) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    labs(y = title_y, x = if(show_x) "Samples per feature" else NULL) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.text.x = if(show_x) element_text(color = "black") else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = if(show_x) element_line() else element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.6),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 10, b = 2, l = 10)
    )
  
  if(show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.2), legend.background = element_blank())
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 4. Build Panels ---
p1 <- make_p("Power", "Power", show_legend = TRUE)

      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "#0000CD", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, color = "#00FF7F", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4)

# --- 6. Save ---
ggsave("Fig1_1D.pdf", final_plot, width = 4, height = 15)
```

```{r}
# --- PARAMETERS ---
n_rep_obs <- 100
n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)

r_true_vec_list <- list(
  c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15),
  c(0.55, 0.5, 0.45),
  c(0.8, 0.75, 0.7)
)

n_sigmas <- 15
ax_ay_val <- -1.0
px_vals_eq <- c(4, 8, 16, 32)
n_cores <- 8
k_comp <- 3

if (!dir.exists("cca_multi_px_results")) dir.create("cca_multi_px_results")

# Creates function
run_stability_batch <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true) {
  
  k <- length(r_true)
  
  # Updates user on current status
  cat(sprintf("\n--- Condition: %s (px=%d, py=%d) r_true=%s ---\n",
              cond_name, px, py, paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = ",")))
  
  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    
    file_path <- sprintf("cca_multi_px_results/%s_px%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
                         cond_name, px,
                         paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"),
                         mod)
    
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next
    
    # Generate population
    model <- generate_cca_population(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = ax_ay_val, 
                                     a_y = ax_ay_val, p_x = px, p_y = py,
                                     r_true = r_true)
    
    # Loops over sample size (n_per_ftr_vec)
    batch_results <- map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)
      
      # Power
      if (n_ptf > 256) {
        p_bonf_val <- rep(1.0, k)
      } else {
        p_bonf_val <- compute_power(joint_cov = model$joint_cov, p_x = px,
          n = n_total, num_datasets = n_rep_obs, num_permutations = 100,
          k = k)
      }
      
      # Computes error metric n_rep_obs times
      # For each replication produce df with k rows
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        
        cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
          n = n_total, p_x = px, k = k)
        
        rel_assoc_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
        weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat,
          model$W_X, model$W_Y)
        score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
        
        data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Rel_Assoc_Err  = rel_assoc_err,
          Weight_Err     = weight_err,
          Score_Err      = score_load$score,
          Load_Err       = score_load$loading
        )
        
      }, simplify = FALSE)
      
      # Average across datasets for same canonical pair
      draws_df <- bind_rows(draws) %>%
        group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        summarise(
          Rel_Assoc_Err = mean(Rel_Assoc_Err),
          Weight_Err    = mean(Weight_Err),
          Score_Err     = mean(Score_Err),
          Load_Err      = mean(Load_Err),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Power_Bonf = p_bonf_val,
          n_per_ftr  = n_ptf
        )
      
      draws_df
    })
    
    # --- Save results ---
    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>%
        mutate(
          px = px,
          py = py,
          r_true = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"),
          mod = mod,
          cond = cond_name
        ),
      file_path
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("Saved mod %d\n", mod))
  }
}

# Parallel Processing
all_tasks <- expand.grid(
  px = px_vals_eq,
  r_idx = seq_along(r_true_vec_list)
) %>%
  mutate(
    py = px,
    cond = "px_eq_py"
  )

mclapply(1:nrow(all_tasks), function(i) {
  
  task <- all_tasks[i, ]
  
  run_stability_batch(
    px = task$px,
    py = task$py,
    cond_name = task$cond,
    r_true = r_true_vec_list[[task$r_idx]]
  )
  
}, mc.cores = n_cores)
```

```{r}
# --- 3. Panel Function ---
make_per_pair_panel <- function(df_data, comp_idx, metric_name,
                                show_y_axis = FALSE,
                                show_linetype_legend = FALSE) {

  sub_df <- df_data %>% filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  legend_vals <- r_values_ref %>%
    filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx) %>%
    pull(Value_Str)

  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
                        color = val_str, linetype = factor(px))) +  # wrap px in factor
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8)

  p <- p + scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "px",  # <-- sets the legend title
    values = c("4"="dotdash", "8"="dashed", "16"="longdash", "32"="solid"),
    guide = if(show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
  )

  # Correlation legend ONLY for Power row
  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    p <- p + annotation_custom(
      grob = tableGrob(
        d = data.frame(r = legend_vals),
        theme = ttheme_minimal(
          base_size = 8,
          core = list(
            fg_params = list(
              fontface = "bold",
              col = color_map_raw[legend_vals],
              hjust = 0, x = 0.1
            ),
            bg_params = list(fill = NA)
          ),
          rowhead = list(
            fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0, fontface = "italic")
          )
        ),
        rows = c(expression(r[true] == ""), "", ""),
        cols = NULL
      ),
      xmin = 20, xmax = 400,
      ymin = 0.02, ymax = 0.3
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_log10(
      limits = c(3, 1100),
      breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
      labels = expression(10^1, 10^2, 10^3)
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      limits = c(1e-3, 1.2),
      breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1),
      labels = expression(10^-3, 10^-2, 10^-1, 10^0)
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_raw, guide = "none") +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = expression(px),
      values = c("4"="dotdash", "8"="dashed", "16"="longdash", "32"="solid"),
      guide = if (show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_linetype_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank()
    )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load Data ---
files <- list.files("cca_multi_px_1d_results", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
if(length(files) == 0) stop("No RDS files found!")
df_raw <- map_df(files, readRDS)

# --- 2. Prepare Data for Plotting ---
df_plot <- df_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(c("Power_Bonf", "Rel_Assoc_Err", "Weight_Err", "Score_Err", "Load_Err")),
    names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    r_true = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(r_true)),  # color mapping
    px = factor(px, levels = c(4, 8, 16, 32)),
    Metric = factor(Metric,
      levels = c("Power_Bonf", "Rel_Assoc_Err", "Weight_Err", "Score_Err", "Load_Err"),
      labels = c("Power", "Relative assocciation error", "Weight error", "Score error", "Loading error")
    ),
    Value = pmax(Value, 1e-4)  # prevent log(0)
  )

# --- 3. Define Colors and Linetypes ---
color_map <- c("0.10" = "#96F3A6", "0.30" = "#45ADA8", "0.70" = "#00008B")
line_map <- c("4" = "dotdash", "8" = "dashed", "16" = "longdash", "32" = "solid")

# --- 4. Plotting Function ---
make_1d_plot <- function(df, metric_name, show_x = FALSE) {
  
  p <- df %>% filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
               color = r_true,
               linetype = px,
               group = interaction(r_true, px))) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = line_map) +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      limits = c(1e-3, 1.2),
      breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1),
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = if(show_x) "Samples per feature" else NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 5. Create Row Plots ---
row_plots <- map(levels(df_plot$Metric), ~ make_1d_plot(df_plot, .x, show_x = (.x == "Loading error")))

# --- 6. Add Row Labels ---

  wrap_elements(textGrob(text, rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")))
}
row_labels <- map(levels(df_plot$Metric), make_row_label)
row_labels_plots <- wrap_plots(row_labels, ncol = 1)

# --- 7. Assemble Final Plot (Single Column) ---
final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  row_labels_plots, wrap_plots(row_plots, ncol = 1),
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(0.12, 1),
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

# --- 8. Save ---
ggsave("Fig2_1D.pdf", final_plot, width = 6, height = 15)
```

# Figure 3
```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = 8)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

results_dir <- "cca_px_plus_py_64_results"
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir)

# ==========================================
# 1. CORE BATCH FUNCTION
# ==========================================
run_stability_batch <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true, n_rep_obs, n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec) {
  k <- length(r_true)
  message(sprintf("\n>>> STARTING: px=%d, py=%d (sum=%d)", px, py, px + py))

  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    file_path <- sprintf(
      "%s/%s_px%d_py%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
      results_dir, cond_name, px, py,
      paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), mod
    )
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next

    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = px, p_y = py, r_true = r_true)

    batch_results <- purrr::map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)

      # Skip unstable case
      if (n_total <= max(px, py)) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      # Compute power
      p_raw <- if (n_ptf > 256) rep(1.0, k) else compute_power(
        joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
        p_x = px, n = n_total,
        num_datasets = n_rep_obs,
        num_permutations = 100,
        k = k
      )

      # Replicate for error metrics
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        tryCatch({
          cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(model$joint_cov, n_total, px, k)
          if (is.null(cca_fit)) return(NULL)
          rel_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
          weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          data.frame(
            Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
            Rel_Assoc_Err = rel_err,
            Weight_Err = weight_err,
            Score_Err = score_load$score,
            Load_Err = score_load$loading
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }, simplify = FALSE)

      draws <- draws[!sapply(draws, is.null)]
      if (length(draws) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      dplyr::bind_rows(draws) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Power_Raw = p_raw, n_per_ftr = n_ptf)
    })

    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>% dplyr::mutate(px = px, py = py, mod = mod, r_true_label = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), cond = cond_name),
      file_path
    )
    cat(sprintf("   Saved mod %d/%d (px=%d, py=%d)\n", mod, n_sigmas, px, py))
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 2. TASK GRID
# ==========================================
n_rep_obs <- 100
n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)
r_true_vec_list <- list(c(0.25,0.2,0.15), c(0.55,0.5,0.45), c(0.8,0.75,0.7))
n_sigmas <- 15
px_vals <- c(4, 8, 16)

all_tasks <- expand.grid(px = px_vals, r_idx = seq_along(r_true_vec_list))
all_tasks$py <- 64 - all_tasks$px
all_tasks$cond <- "px_plus_py_64"

# ==========================================
# 3. PARALLEL EXECUTION
# ==========================================
results <- future_lapply(1:nrow(all_tasks), function(i) {
  task <- all_tasks[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n[Task %d/%d] px=%d, py=%d\n", i, nrow(all_tasks), task$px, task$py))
  tryCatch({
    run_stability_batch(
      px = task$px, py = task$py, cond_name = task$cond,
      r_true = r_true_vec_list[[task$r_idx]],
      n_rep_obs = n_rep_obs, n_sigmas = n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec = n_per_ftr_vec
    )
    "OK"
  }, error = function(e) {
    msg <- sprintf("FAILED: px=%d py=%d | %s", task$px, task$py, e$message)
    cat(msg, "\n")
    msg
  })
}, future.seed = TRUE)
```

```{r}
make_per_pair_panel <- function(df_data, comp_idx, metric_name,
                                show_y_axis = FALSE,
                                show_linetype_legend = FALSE) {

  sub_df <- df_data %>% filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  legend_vals <- r_values_ref %>%
    filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx) %>%
    pull(Value_Str)

  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
                          color = val_str, linetype = px_f)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8)

  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    p <- p + annotation_custom(
      grob = tableGrob(
        d = data.frame(r = legend_vals),
        theme = ttheme_minimal(
          base_size = 8,
          core = list(
            fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", col = color_map_raw[legend_vals], hjust = 0, x = 0.1),
            bg_params = list(fill = NA)
          ),
          rowhead = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0, fontface = "italic"))
        ),
        rows = c(expression(r[true] == ""), "", ""),
        cols = NULL
      ),
      # CHANGED: xmin from 20 to 100, xmax from 400 to 800 to shift right
      xmin = 100, xmax = 800, ymin = 0.02, ymax = 0.3
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(3, 1100), breaks = c(10, 100, 1000), labels = expression(10^1, 10^2, 10^3)) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-3, 1.2), breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1), labels = expression(10^-3, 10^-2, 10^-1, 10^0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_raw, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("4" = "dotted", "8" = "dotdash", "16" = "dashed", "32" = "solid"),
      labels = c("4" = "4", "8" = "8", "16" = "16", "32" = "32"),
      guide = if (show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_linetype_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  }
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = 8)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

results_dir <- "cca_px_plus_py_64_1d_results"
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir)

# ==========================================
# 1. CORE BATCH FUNCTION
# ==========================================
run_stability_batch_k1 <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true, n_rep_obs, n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec) {
  k <- 1
  message(sprintf("\n>>> STARTING: px=%d, py=%d (sum=%d)", px, py, px + py))

  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    file_path <- sprintf(
      "%s/%s_px%d_py%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
      results_dir, cond_name, px, py,
      paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), mod
    )
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next

    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = px, p_y = py, r_true = r_true)

    batch_results <- purrr::map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)

      # Skip unstable case
      if (n_total <= max(px, py)) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      # Compute power
      p_raw <- if (n_ptf > 256) 1.0 else compute_power_1d(
        joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
        p_x = px, n = n_total,
        num_datasets = n_rep_obs,
        num_permutations = 100
      )

      # Replicate for error metrics
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        tryCatch({
          cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(model$joint_cov, n_total, px, k)
          if (is.null(cca_fit)) return(NULL)
          rel_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
          weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          data.frame(
            Canonical_Pair = 1,
            Rel_Assoc_Err = rel_err,
            Weight_Err = weight_err,
            Score_Err = score_load$score,
            Load_Err = score_load$loading
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }, simplify = FALSE)

      draws <- draws[!sapply(draws, is.null)]
      if (length(draws) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      dplyr::bind_rows(draws) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Power_Raw = p_raw, n_per_ftr = n_ptf)
    })

    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>% dplyr::mutate(px = px, py = py, mod = mod, r_true_label = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), cond = cond_name),
      file_path
    )
  }
}

n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)

  }, error = function(e) {
    msg <- sprintf("FAILED: px=%d py=%d | %s", task$px, task$py, e$message)
    cat(msg, "\n")
    msg
  })
}, future.seed = TRUE)
```

# Univariate CCA

## Make population

### Generate within set covariance

```{r}
# power-law eigenvalue/spectrum vector sigma_i = c * i^{-a}
power_law_sigma <- function(c, a, p) {
  stopifnot(length(c) == 1, length(a) == 1, length(p) == 1)
  if (!is.numeric(c) || !is.numeric(a) || !is.numeric(p)) stop("c, a, p must be numeric.")
  if (p <= 0 || p != as.integer(p)) stop("p must be a positive integer.")
  if (c <= 0) stop("c must be > 0 to make a valid covariance.")
  
  i <- seq_len(p)
  sigma <- c * (i ^ (a))
  return(sigma)
}

# generate Sigma_XX and Sigma_YY (both diagonal)
generate_within_set_cov <- function(c_xx, c_yy, a_xx, a_yy, p_x, p_y,
                                    check_monotone = TRUE) {
  sigma_x <- power_law_sigma(c = c_xx, a = a_xx, p = p_x)
  sigma_y <- power_law_sigma(c = c_yy, a = a_yy, p = p_y)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(sigma_x)) || any(!is.finite(sigma_y))) {
    stop("Non-finite values in sigma. Check c/a/p.")
  }
  if (any(sigma_x <= 0) || any(sigma_y <= 0)) {
    stop("All sigma entries must be > 0 for a valid (PD) diagonal covariance.")
  }
  
  if (check_monotone) {
    # "Decay" here means sigma_1 >= sigma_2 >= ... >= sigma_p
    if (any(diff(sigma_x) > 0)) warning("sigma_x is not non-increasing; check sign/magnitude of a_xx.")
    if (any(diff(sigma_y) > 0)) warning("sigma_y is not non-increasing; check sign/magnitude of a_yy.")
  }
  
  Sigma_xx <- diag(sigma_x, nrow = p_x, ncol = p_x)
  Sigma_yy <- diag(sigma_y, nrow = p_y, ncol = p_y)
  
  return(list(
    Sigma_XX = Sigma_xx,
    Sigma_YY = Sigma_yy,
    sigma_XX = sigma_x,
    sigma_YY = sigma_y
  ))
}
```

### Generate weights

```{r}
# draw one unit Euclidean vector
draw_unit_vector <- function(p) {
  z <- rnorm(p)
  nz <- sqrt(sum(z^2))
  if (nz == 0) stop("Zero-norm draw (extremely unlikely).")
  z / nz
}

# quadratic form for diagonal Sigma
quad_form_diag <- function(w, sigma) {
  sum(sigma * w^2)
}

# Eq (11) check
passes_eq11 <- function(tilde_w, sigma, factor = 1/2) {
  p <- ncol(sigma)
  lhs <- quad_form_diag(tilde_w, sigma)
  rhs <- factor * (sum(sigma) / p)  # factor * tr(Sigma)/p
  list(pass = (lhs > rhs), lhs = lhs, rhs = rhs)
}

# Eq (10) normalization
normalize_eq10 <- function(tilde_w, sigma) {
  denom2 <- quad_form_diag(tilde_w, sigma)  # tilde_w^T Sigma tilde_w
  if (denom2 <= 0) stop("Non-positive quadratic form; sigma must be > 0.")
  tilde_w / sqrt(denom2)
}

# generate a CCA weight vector
generate_weight_one_mode <- function(sigma, factor = 1/2, max_tries = 100000, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  p <- ncol(sigma)
  if (any(sigma < 0)) stop("All sigma entries must be > 0.")

  for (k in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    tilde_w <- draw_unit_vector(p)          # ||tilde_w||_2 = 1
    chk <- passes_eq11(tilde_w, sigma, factor = factor)
    if (chk$pass) {
      w <- normalize_eq10(tilde_w, sigma)   # now w^T Sigma w = 1

      return(list(
        tilde_w = tilde_w,
        w = w,
        tries = k,
        eq11_lhs = chk$lhs,
        eq11_rhs = chk$rhs
      ))
    }
  }
  stop("Failed to find a tilde_w passing Eq (11) within max_tries. Consider lowering factor or max_tries.")
}

# generate both W_X and W_Y (rank-1)
generate_Wx_Wy_eq10eq11 <- function(sigma_xx, sigma_yy, factor = 1/2, max_tries = 100000, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  out_x <- generate_weight_one_mode(sigma_xx, factor = factor, max_tries = max_tries)
  out_y <- generate_weight_one_mode(sigma_yy, factor = factor, max_tries = max_tries)
  list(
    W_X = matrix(out_x$w, ncol = 1),
    W_Y = matrix(out_y$w, ncol = 1),
    details_X = out_x,
    details_Y = out_y
  )
}
```

### Compute U, V, and S

```{r}
mat_sqrt_spd <- function(Sigma, inverse = FALSE, tol = 1e-12) {
  # If Sigma is given as diagonal entries
  if (is.vector(Sigma)) {
    if (any(Sigma <= 0)) stop("Diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    d <- if (!inverse) sqrt(Sigma) else 1 / sqrt(Sigma)
    return(diag(d, nrow = length(d), ncol = length(d)))
  }
  
  # Sigma is a matrix
  if (!is.matrix(Sigma)) stop("Sigma must be a vector (diag) or a matrix.")
  if (nrow(Sigma) != ncol(Sigma)) stop("Sigma must be square.")
  
  # Fast path: (approximately) diagonal
  off_diag <- Sigma
  diag(off_diag) <- 0
  if (max(abs(off_diag)) < tol) {
    d0 <- diag(Sigma)
    if (any(d0 <= 0)) stop("Diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    d <- if (!inverse) sqrt(d0) else 1 / sqrt(d0)
    return(diag(d, nrow = length(d), ncol = length(d)))
  }
  
  # eigen decomposition
  eig <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
  if (any(eig$values <= tol)) stop("Sigma not SPD (non-positive eigenvalues).")
  vals <- if (!inverse) sqrt(eig$values) else 1 / sqrt(eig$values)
  eig$vectors %*% diag(vals) %*% t(eig$vectors)
}

# For rank-1 (m=1) or multi-mode if r is a vector of length m
compute_uvs_from_weights <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true) {
  if (!is.matrix(W_X)) W_X <- matrix(W_X, ncol = 1)
  if (!is.matrix(W_Y)) W_Y <- matrix(W_Y, ncol = 1)
  m <- ncol(W_X)
  if (ncol(W_Y) != m) stop("W_X and W_Y must have the same number of columns (m).")
  
  # S
  if (length(r_true) == 1) {
    S <- diag(rep(r_true, m), nrow = m, ncol = m)
  } else {
    if (length(r_true) != m) stop("If r_true is a vector, it must have length m.")
    S <- diag(r_true, nrow = m, ncol = m)
  }
  
  sqrt_x <- mat_sqrt_spd(Sigma_XX, inverse = FALSE)
  sqrt_y <- mat_sqrt_spd(Sigma_YY, inverse = FALSE)
  
  U <- sqrt_x %*% W_X
  V <- sqrt_y %*% W_Y
  
  list(U = U, V = V, S = S)
}
```

### Generate between set covariance

```{r}
# Generate between-set covariance Sigma_XY for CCA
generate_Sigma_XY <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true,
                              allow_negative = FALSE) {
  # Coerce weights to matrices
  if (!is.matrix(W_X)) W_X <- matrix(W_X, ncol = 1)
  if (!is.matrix(W_Y)) W_Y <- matrix(W_Y, ncol = 1)

  p_x <- nrow(W_X)
  p_y <- nrow(W_Y)
  m   <- ncol(W_X)
  if (ncol(W_Y) != m) stop("W_X and W_Y must have the same number of columns (m).")

  # r_true to S
  if (length(r_true) == 1) {
    r_vec <- rep(r_true, m)
  } else {
    if (length(r_true) != m) stop("If r_true is a vector, it must have length m.")
    r_vec <- r_true
  }

  if (!allow_negative && any(r_vec < 0)) stop("CCA uses nonnegative canonical correlations; r_true should be >= 0.")
  if (any(abs(r_vec) >= 1)) stop("Need |r_true| < 1 for a valid joint covariance (strict PD typically).")

  S <- diag(r_vec, nrow = m, ncol = m)

  # Decide if Sigma_XX / Sigma_YY are diagonal vectors or full matrices
  is_diagvec_x <- is.vector(Sigma_XX) && !is.list(Sigma_XX)
  is_diagvec_y <- is.vector(Sigma_YY) && !is.list(Sigma_YY)

  if (is_diagvec_x) {
    if (length(Sigma_XX) != p_x) stop("Length of diagonal vector Sigma_XX must equal nrow(W_X).")
    if (any(Sigma_XX <= 0)) stop("Sigma_XX diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    # A = Sigma_XX W_X = diag(sigma_x) W_X  (rowwise multiply)
    A <- sweep(W_X, 1, Sigma_XX, "*")
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_XX) || nrow(Sigma_XX) != p_x || ncol(Sigma_XX) != p_x)
      stop("Sigma_XX must be p_x x p_x matrix or length p_x diagonal vector.")
    A <- Sigma_XX %*% W_X
  }

  if (is_diagvec_y) {
    if (length(Sigma_YY) != p_y) stop("Length of diagonal vector Sigma_YY must equal nrow(W_Y).")
    if (any(Sigma_YY <= 0)) stop("Sigma_YY diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    # B = Sigma_YY W_Y = diag(sigma_y) W_Y
    B <- sweep(W_Y, 1, Sigma_YY, "*")
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_YY) || nrow(Sigma_YY) != p_y || ncol(Sigma_YY) != p_y)
      stop("Sigma_YY must be p_y x p_y matrix or length p_y diagonal vector.")
    B <- Sigma_YY %*% W_Y
  }
  
  Sigma_XY <- A %*% S %*% t(B)
  return(Sigma_XY)
}

```

### Generate covariance

```{r}
assemble_joint_cov <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, Sigma_XY) {
  # Determine dimensions
  p_x <- nrow(Sigma_XY)
  p_y <- ncol(Sigma_XY)

  # Convert Sigma_XX
  if (is.vector(Sigma_XX) && !is.list(Sigma_XX)) {
    if (length(Sigma_XX) != p_x) stop("Length of Sigma_XX diagonal vector must equal nrow(Sigma_XY).")
    Sigma_xx_mat <- diag(Sigma_XX, nrow = p_x, ncol = p_x)
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_XX) || nrow(Sigma_XX) != p_x || ncol(Sigma_XX) != p_x) {
      stop("Sigma_XX must be p_x x p_x matrix or length p_x diagonal vector.")
    }
    Sigma_xx_mat <- Sigma_XX
  }

  # Convert Sigma_YY
  if (is.vector(Sigma_YY) && !is.list(Sigma_YY)) {
    if (length(Sigma_YY) != p_y) stop("Length of Sigma_YY diagonal vector must equal ncol(Sigma_XY).")
    Sigma_yy_mat <- diag(Sigma_YY, nrow = p_y, ncol = p_y)
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_YY) || nrow(Sigma_YY) != p_y || ncol(Sigma_YY) != p_y) {
      stop("Sigma_YY must be p_y x p_y matrix or length p_y diagonal vector.")
    }
    Sigma_yy_mat <- Sigma_YY
  }

  # Assemble
  Sigma <- rbind(
    cbind(Sigma_xx_mat, Sigma_XY),
    cbind(t(Sigma_XY), Sigma_yy_mat)
  )

  # Symmetrize to remove tiny numerical asymmetry
  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  Sigma
}

# Quick PD check using Cholesky
is_pos_def <- function(Sigma) {
  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  ok <- TRUE
  chol_try <- tryCatch(chol(Sigma), error = function(e) { ok <<- FALSE; NULL })
  ok
}
```

## Helper functions

### Population CCA

```{r}
make_population_cca <- function(
  c_xx = 1, c_yy = 1,
  a_xx = -1, a_yy = -1,
  p_x = 100, p_y = 100,
  r_true = 0.3,
  seed = 1,
  make_pd = TRUE,
  eps = 1e-10
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  covs <- generate_within_set_cov(c_xx, c_yy, a_xx, a_yy, p_x, p_y)
  Sigma_XX <- covs$Sigma_XX
  Sigma_YY <- covs$Sigma_YY

  # Generate weights using Eq10/Eq11
  w_try <- tryCatch(
    generate_Wx_Wy_eq10eq11(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, seed = seed),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(w_try)) {
    w_try <- generate_Wx_Wy_eq10eq11(covs$sigma_XX, covs$sigma_YY, seed = seed)
  }

  W_X <- w_try$W_X
  W_Y <- w_try$W_Y

  Sigma_XY <- generate_Sigma_XY(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true)
  Sigma <- assemble_joint_cov(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, Sigma_XY)

  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  if (make_pd && exists("is_pos_def") && exists("make_pos_def")) {
    if (!is_pos_def(Sigma)) Sigma <- make_pos_def(Sigma, eps = eps)
  }

  list(
    Sigma = Sigma,
    Sigma_XX = Sigma_XX,
    Sigma_YY = Sigma_YY,
    Sigma_XY = Sigma_XY,
    wX_true = as.numeric(W_X[, 1]),
    wY_true = as.numeric(W_Y[, 1]),
    p_x = p_x,
    p_y = p_y,
    r_true = r_true
  )
}
```

### Darw sample and sample CCA

```{r}
# Hybrid draw of sample covariance: Wishart when df >= d, else explicit sampling
draw_sample_cov_hybrid <- function(Sigma, n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  d <- ncol(Sigma)
  n <- max(as.integer(n), 3)

  if ((n - 1) >= d) {
    W <- stats::rWishart(1, df = n - 1, Sigma = Sigma)[,,1]
    return(W / (n - 1))
  }

  # explicit sampling (cheap when n small)
  Sig <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  R <- chol(Sig + 1e-12 * diag(d))
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(n * d), nrow = n, ncol = d)
  X <- scale(Z %*% R, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  crossprod(X) / (n - 1)
}

cca_from_sample_cov_1 <- function(Sxx, Syy, Sxy) {

  ex <- eigen(Sxx, symmetric = TRUE)
  ey <- eigen(Syy, symmetric = TRUE)

  invsqrt_x <- ex$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(pmax(ex$values, 1e-10))) %*% t(ex$vectors)
  invsqrt_y <- ey$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(pmax(ey$values, 1e-10))) %*% t(ey$vectors)

  M <- invsqrt_x %*% Sxy %*% invsqrt_y
  sv <- svd(M)

  u1 <- sv$u[, 1]
  v1 <- sv$v[, 1]

  wX_hat <- as.numeric(invsqrt_x %*% u1)
  wY_hat <- as.numeric(invsqrt_y %*% v1)

  list(r_hat = sv$d[1], wX_hat = wX_hat, wY_hat = wY_hat)
}

normalize_eq10 <- function(tilde_w, sigma) {
  denom2 <- quad_form_diag(tilde_w, sigma)  # tilde_w^T Sigma tilde_w
  if (denom2 <= 0) stop("Non-positive quadratic form; sigma must be > 0.")
  tilde_w / sqrt(denom2)
}

align_sign <- function(w_hat, w_true) {
  s <- sign(sum(w_hat * w_true))
  if (s == 0) s <- 1
  s * w_hat
}
```

### Weight stability, Cosine similarity, and PC1

```{r}
if (!exists("cos_sim")) {
  cos_sim <- function(a, b) {
    a <- as.numeric(a); b <- as.numeric(b)
    sum(a*b) / (sqrt(sum(a^2))*sqrt(sum(b^2)) + 1e-12)
  }
}

# E|cos(u, e1)| for random unit u in R^p
expected_abs_cos_random <- function(p) {
  if (p <= 1) return(1)
  2/(p - 1) * exp(lgamma(p/2) - 0.5*log(pi) - lgamma((p - 1)/2))
}

pc1_from_cov <- function(Sxx) {
  eg <- eigen(Sxx, symmetric = TRUE)
  v <- eg$vectors[, 1]
  as.numeric(v / sqrt(sum(v^2)))
}

stability_from_xy_weight_matrices <- function(WX, WY) {
  WX <- sweep(WX, 2, sqrt(colSums(WX^2)), "/")
  WY <- sweep(WY, 2, sqrt(colSums(WY^2)), "/")
  
  GX <- abs(crossprod(WX))
  GY <- abs(crossprod(WY))
  
  idx <- upper.tri(GX)
  mean(pmin(GX[idx], GY[idx]))
}
```

```{r}
# Set parameter values
spf_vec <- c(4, 64, 1024)
c_xx <- 1
c_yy <- 1
a_xx <- -1
a_yy <- -1
p_x <- 100
p_y <- 100
r_true <- 0.3
factor <- 1/2
seed_pop <- 1008913972

# Create population object
pop <- make_population_cca(
  c_xx = c_xx,
  c_yy = c_yy,
  a_xx = a_xx,
  a_yy = a_yy,
  p_x = p_x,
  p_y = p_y,
  r_true = r_true,
  seed = seed_pop
)

# Total dimension
p_total <- p_x + p_y

# Empty list to store results
out <- vector("list", length(spf_vec))

# Loop over samples-per-feature values
for (i in seq_along(spf_vec)) {
  
  spf <- spf_vec[i]
  n <- as.integer(round(spf * p_total))
  
  # Draw sample covariance
  S <- draw_sample_cov_hybrid(pop$Sigma, n = n, seed = seed_pop + spf)
  
  # Extract covariance blocks
  Sxx <- S[1:p_x, 1:p_x]
  Syy <- S[(p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y), (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y)]
  Sxy <- S[1:p_x, (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y)]
  
  # Fit CCA from sample covariance
  fit <- cca_from_sample_cov_1(Sxx, Syy, Sxy)
  
  # Normalize and align estimated X weights
  wX_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$wX_hat, pop$Sigma_XX)
  wX_hat <- align_sign(wX_hat, pop$wX_true)
  
  # Store result for this spf
  out[[i]] <- data.frame(
    pc = 1:p_x,
    diff = wX_hat - pop$wX_true,
    samples_per_feature = factor(spf, levels = spf_vec)
  )
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
```

```{r}
    c_xx, c_yy, a_xx, a_yy, p_x, p_y,
    r_true = r_true,

  )
```

# Multivariate CCA

## Make population

### Generate within set covariance

```{r}
# power-law eigenvalue/spectrum vector sigma_i = c * i^{-a}
power_law_sigma <- function(c, a, p) {
  stopifnot(length(c) == 1, length(a) == 1, length(p) == 1)
  if (!is.numeric(c) || !is.numeric(a) || !is.numeric(p)) stop("c, a, p must be numeric.")
  if (p <= 0 || p != as.integer(p)) stop("p must be a positive integer.")
  if (c <= 0) stop("c must be > 0 to make a valid covariance.")
  
  i <- seq_len(p)
  sigma <- c * (i ^ (a))
  return(sigma)
}

# generate Sigma_XX and Sigma_YY (both diagonal)
generate_within_set_cov <- function(c_xx, c_yy, a_xx, a_yy, p_x, p_y,
                                    check_monotone = TRUE) {
  sigma_x <- power_law_sigma(c = c_xx, a = a_xx, p = p_x)
  sigma_y <- power_law_sigma(c = c_yy, a = a_yy, p = p_y)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(sigma_x)) || any(!is.finite(sigma_y))) {
    stop("Non-finite values in sigma. Check c/a/p.")
  }
  if (any(sigma_x <= 0) || any(sigma_y <= 0)) {
    stop("All sigma entries must be > 0 for a valid (PD) diagonal covariance.")
  }
  
  if (check_monotone) {
    # "Decay" here means sigma_1 >= sigma_2 >= ... >= sigma_p
    if (any(diff(sigma_x) > 0)) warning("sigma_x is not non-increasing; check sign/magnitude of a_xx.")
    if (any(diff(sigma_y) > 0)) warning("sigma_y is not non-increasing; check sign/magnitude of a_yy.")
  }
  
  Sigma_xx <- diag(sigma_x, nrow = p_x, ncol = p_x)
  Sigma_yy <- diag(sigma_y, nrow = p_y, ncol = p_y)
  
  return(list(
    Sigma_XX = Sigma_xx,
    Sigma_YY = Sigma_yy,
    sigma_XX = sigma_x,
    sigma_YY = sigma_y
  ))
}
```

### Generate weights

```{r}
# draw one unit Euclidean vector
draw_unit_vector <- function(p) {
  z <- rnorm(p)
  nz <- sqrt(sum(z^2))
  if (nz == 0) stop("Zero-norm draw (extremely unlikely).")
  z / nz
}

# draw p x r matrix with Euclidean-orthonormal columns
draw_orthonormal_matrix <- function(p, r) {
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(p * r), nrow = p, ncol = r)
  qr.Q(qr(Z), complete = FALSE)
}

# helper: trace(Sigma) for either a full matrix or diagonal vector
trace_sigma <- function(sigma) {
  if (is.vector(sigma)) return(sum(sigma))
  sum(diag(sigma))
}

# helper: number of rows / columns in Sigma
sigma_dim <- function(sigma) {
  if (is.vector(sigma)) return(length(sigma))
  ncol(sigma)
}

# quadratic form w^T Sigma w for one vector
quad_form_diag <- function(w, sigma) {
  if (is.vector(sigma)) {
    sum(sigma * w^2)
  } else {
    as.numeric(crossprod(w, sigma %*% w))
  }
}

# matrix quadratic form trace(W^T Sigma W)
quad_form_diag_mat <- function(W, sigma) {
  W <- as.matrix(W)
  if (is.vector(sigma)) {
    sum(W^2 * sigma)
  } else {
    sum(diag(crossprod(W, sigma %*% W)))
  }
}

# inverse square root of a small SPD matrix
mat_inv_sqrt_spd_small <- function(M, tol = 1e-12) {
  eig <- eigen((M + t(M)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE)
  vals <- eig$values
  vecs <- eig$vectors

  if (any(vals <= tol)) {
    stop("Matrix is not sufficiently positive definite for inverse square root.")
  }

  vecs %*% diag(1 / sqrt(vals), nrow = length(vals)) %*% t(vecs)
}

# Eq (11) check for multi-mode tilde_W
# natural r-dimensional extension:
# tr(tilde_W^T Sigma tilde_W) > factor * r * tr(Sigma) / p
passes_eq11_multi <- function(tilde_W, sigma, factor = 1/2) {
  tilde_W <- as.matrix(tilde_W)
  p <- sigma_dim(sigma)
  r <- ncol(tilde_W)

  if (nrow(tilde_W) != p) {
    stop("tilde_W row dimension must match Sigma dimension.")
  }

  lhs <- quad_form_diag_mat(tilde_W, sigma)
  rhs <- factor * r * trace_sigma(sigma) / p

  list(pass = (lhs > rhs), lhs = lhs, rhs = rhs)
}

# Eq (10) normalization for matrix weights:
# W = tilde_W (tilde_W^T Sigma tilde_W)^(-1/2)
# so that W^T Sigma W = I_r
normalize_eq10_matrix <- function(tilde_W, sigma, tol = 1e-12) {
  tilde_W <- as.matrix(tilde_W)

  if (is.vector(sigma)) {
    G <- crossprod(tilde_W, sweep(tilde_W, 1, sigma, "*"))
  } else {
    G <- crossprod(tilde_W, sigma %*% tilde_W)
  }

  G_inv_sqrt <- mat_inv_sqrt_spd_small(G, tol = tol)
  tilde_W %*% G_inv_sqrt
}

# generate a CCA weight matrix W with r columns
generate_weight_multi_mode <- function(sigma, r,
                                       factor = 1/2,
                                       max_tries = 100000,
                                       seed = NULL,
                                       tol = 1e-12) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  p <- sigma_dim(sigma)
  if (r > p) stop("r must be <= p.")

  if (is.vector(sigma)) {
    if (any(sigma <= 0)) stop("All sigma diagonal entries must be > 0.")
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(sigma) || nrow(sigma) != ncol(sigma)) {
      stop("sigma must be a square covariance matrix (or diagonal vector).")
    }
  }

  for (k in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    tilde_W <- draw_orthonormal_matrix(p, r)   # tilde_W^T tilde_W = I_r
    chk <- passes_eq11_multi(tilde_W, sigma, factor = factor)

    if (chk$pass) {
      W <- normalize_eq10_matrix(tilde_W, sigma, tol = tol)  # now W^T Sigma W = I_r

      return(list(
        tilde_W = tilde_W,
        W = W,
        tries = k,
        eq11_lhs = chk$lhs,
        eq11_rhs = chk$rhs
      ))
    }
  }

  stop("Failed to find a tilde_W passing multivariate Eq (11) within max_tries.")
}

# generate both W_X and W_Y for rank-r CCA
generate_Wx_Wy_eq10eq11 <- function(sigma_xx, sigma_yy, r = 3,
                                    factor = 1/2,
                                    max_tries = 100000,
                                    seed = NULL,
                                    tol = 1e-12) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  out_x <- generate_weight_multi_mode(
    sigma = sigma_xx,
    r = r,
    factor = factor,
    max_tries = max_tries,
    seed = NULL,
    tol = tol
  )

  out_y <- generate_weight_multi_mode(
    sigma = sigma_yy,
    r = r,
    factor = factor,
    max_tries = max_tries,
    seed = NULL,
    tol = tol
  )

  list(
    W_X = out_x$W,
    W_Y = out_y$W,
    details_X = out_x,
    details_Y = out_y
  )
}
```

### Compute U, V, and S

```{r}
mat_sqrt_spd <- function(Sigma, inverse = FALSE, tol = 1e-12) {
  # If Sigma is given as diagonal entries
  if (is.vector(Sigma)) {
    if (any(Sigma <= 0)) stop("Diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    d <- if (!inverse) sqrt(Sigma) else 1 / sqrt(Sigma)
    return(diag(d, nrow = length(d), ncol = length(d)))
  }
  
  # Sigma is a matrix
  if (!is.matrix(Sigma)) stop("Sigma must be a vector (diag) or a matrix.")
  if (nrow(Sigma) != ncol(Sigma)) stop("Sigma must be square.")
  
  # Fast path: (approximately) diagonal
  off_diag <- Sigma
  diag(off_diag) <- 0
  if (max(abs(off_diag)) < tol) {
    d0 <- diag(Sigma)
    if (any(d0 <= 0)) stop("Diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    d <- if (!inverse) sqrt(d0) else 1 / sqrt(d0)
    return(diag(d, nrow = length(d), ncol = length(d)))
  }
  
  # eigen decomposition
  eig <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
  if (any(eig$values <= tol)) stop("Sigma not SPD (non-positive eigenvalues).")
  vals <- if (!inverse) sqrt(eig$values) else 1 / sqrt(eig$values)
  eig$vectors %*% diag(vals) %*% t(eig$vectors)
}

# For rank-1 (m=1) or multi-mode if r is a vector of length m
compute_uvs_from_weights <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true) {
  if (!is.matrix(W_X)) W_X <- matrix(W_X, ncol = 1)
  if (!is.matrix(W_Y)) W_Y <- matrix(W_Y, ncol = 1)
  m <- ncol(W_X)
  if (ncol(W_Y) != m) stop("W_X and W_Y must have the same number of columns (m).")
  
  # S
  if (length(r_true) == 1) {
    S <- diag(rep(r_true, m), nrow = m, ncol = m)
  } else {
    if (length(r_true) != m) stop("If r_true is a vector, it must have length m.")
    S <- diag(r_true, nrow = m, ncol = m)
  }
  
  sqrt_x <- mat_sqrt_spd(Sigma_XX, inverse = FALSE)
  sqrt_y <- mat_sqrt_spd(Sigma_YY, inverse = FALSE)
  
  U <- sqrt_x %*% W_X
  V <- sqrt_y %*% W_Y
  
  list(U = U, V = V, S = S)
}
```

### Generate between set covariance

```{r}
# Generate between-set covariance Sigma_XY for CCA
generate_Sigma_XY <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true,
                              allow_negative = FALSE) {
  # Coerce weights to matrices
  if (!is.matrix(W_X)) W_X <- matrix(W_X, ncol = 1)
  if (!is.matrix(W_Y)) W_Y <- matrix(W_Y, ncol = 1)

  p_x <- nrow(W_X)
  p_y <- nrow(W_Y)
  m   <- ncol(W_X)
  if (ncol(W_Y) != m) stop("W_X and W_Y must have the same number of columns (m).")

  # r_true to S
  if (length(r_true) == 1) {
    r_vec <- rep(r_true, m)
  } else {
    if (length(r_true) != m) stop("If r_true is a vector, it must have length m.")
    r_vec <- r_true
  }

  if (!allow_negative && any(r_vec < 0)) stop("CCA uses nonnegative canonical correlations; r_true should be >= 0.")
  if (any(abs(r_vec) >= 1)) stop("Need |r_true| < 1 for a valid joint covariance (strict PD typically).")

  S <- diag(r_vec, nrow = m, ncol = m)

  # Decide if Sigma_XX / Sigma_YY are diagonal vectors or full matrices
  is_diagvec_x <- is.vector(Sigma_XX) && !is.list(Sigma_XX)
  is_diagvec_y <- is.vector(Sigma_YY) && !is.list(Sigma_YY)

  if (is_diagvec_x) {
    if (length(Sigma_XX) != p_x) stop("Length of diagonal vector Sigma_XX must equal nrow(W_X).")
    if (any(Sigma_XX <= 0)) stop("Sigma_XX diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    # A = Sigma_XX W_X = diag(sigma_x) W_X  (rowwise multiply)
    A <- sweep(W_X, 1, Sigma_XX, "*")
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_XX) || nrow(Sigma_XX) != p_x || ncol(Sigma_XX) != p_x)
      stop("Sigma_XX must be p_x x p_x matrix or length p_x diagonal vector.")
    A <- Sigma_XX %*% W_X
  }

  if (is_diagvec_y) {
    if (length(Sigma_YY) != p_y) stop("Length of diagonal vector Sigma_YY must equal nrow(W_Y).")
    if (any(Sigma_YY <= 0)) stop("Sigma_YY diagonal entries must be > 0.")
    # B = Sigma_YY W_Y = diag(sigma_y) W_Y
    B <- sweep(W_Y, 1, Sigma_YY, "*")
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_YY) || nrow(Sigma_YY) != p_y || ncol(Sigma_YY) != p_y)
      stop("Sigma_YY must be p_y x p_y matrix or length p_y diagonal vector.")
    B <- Sigma_YY %*% W_Y
  }
  
  Sigma_XY <- A %*% S %*% t(B)
  return(Sigma_XY)
}

```

### Generate covariance

```{r}
assemble_joint_cov <- function(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, Sigma_XY) {
  # Determine dimensions
  p_x <- nrow(Sigma_XY)
  p_y <- ncol(Sigma_XY)

  # Convert Sigma_XX
  if (is.vector(Sigma_XX) && !is.list(Sigma_XX)) {
    if (length(Sigma_XX) != p_x) stop("Length of Sigma_XX diagonal vector must equal nrow(Sigma_XY).")
    Sigma_xx_mat <- diag(Sigma_XX, nrow = p_x, ncol = p_x)
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_XX) || nrow(Sigma_XX) != p_x || ncol(Sigma_XX) != p_x) {
      stop("Sigma_XX must be p_x x p_x matrix or length p_x diagonal vector.")
    }
    Sigma_xx_mat <- Sigma_XX
  }

  # Convert Sigma_YY
  if (is.vector(Sigma_YY) && !is.list(Sigma_YY)) {
    if (length(Sigma_YY) != p_y) stop("Length of Sigma_YY diagonal vector must equal ncol(Sigma_XY).")
    Sigma_yy_mat <- diag(Sigma_YY, nrow = p_y, ncol = p_y)
  } else {
    if (!is.matrix(Sigma_YY) || nrow(Sigma_YY) != p_y || ncol(Sigma_YY) != p_y) {
      stop("Sigma_YY must be p_y x p_y matrix or length p_y diagonal vector.")
    }
    Sigma_yy_mat <- Sigma_YY
  }

  # Assemble
  Sigma <- rbind(
    cbind(Sigma_xx_mat, Sigma_XY),
    cbind(t(Sigma_XY), Sigma_yy_mat)
  )

  # Symmetrize to remove tiny numerical asymmetry
  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  Sigma
}

# Quick PD check using Cholesky
is_pos_def <- function(Sigma) {
  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  ok <- TRUE
  chol_try <- tryCatch(chol(Sigma), error = function(e) { ok <<- FALSE; NULL })
  ok
}
```

## Helper functions

### Population CCA

```{r}
expand_r_true <- function(r_true, r) {
  if (length(r_true) == 1L) {
    rep(as.numeric(r_true), r)
  } else {
    if (length(r_true) != r) stop("If r_true is a vector, it must have length r.")
    as.numeric(r_true)
  }
}

make_population_cca <- function(
  c_xx = 1, c_yy = 1,
  a_xx = -1, a_yy = -1,
  p_x = 100, p_y = 100,
  r = 3,
  r_true = c(0.7, 0.5, 0.3),
  factor = 1/2,
  seed = 1,
  max_tries = 100000,
  make_pd = TRUE,
  eps = 1e-10,
  tol = 1e-12
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  if (r > min(p_x, p_y)) stop("r must be <= min(p_x, p_y).")

  covs <- generate_within_set_cov(c_xx, c_yy, a_xx, a_yy, p_x, p_y)
  Sigma_XX <- covs$Sigma_XX
  Sigma_YY <- covs$Sigma_YY

  r_vec <- expand_r_true(r_true, r)
  if (any(r_vec < 0) || any(r_vec >= 1)) {
    stop("For regular CCA, r_true entries must satisfy 0 <= r_true < 1.")
  }

  weights <- generate_Wx_Wy_eq10eq11(
    sigma_xx = Sigma_XX,
    sigma_yy = Sigma_YY,
    r = r,
    factor = factor,
    max_tries = max_tries,
    seed = seed,
    tol = tol
  )

  W_X <- weights$W_X
  W_Y <- weights$W_Y

  UVS <- compute_uvs_from_weights(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, W_X, W_Y, r_true)
  U_true <- UVS$U
  V_true <- UVS$V
  S <- UVS$S
  Sigma_XY <- generate_Sigma_XY(
    Sigma_XX = Sigma_XX,
    Sigma_YY = Sigma_YY,
    W_X = W_X,
    W_Y = W_Y,
    r_true = r_vec
  )

  Sigma <- assemble_joint_cov(Sigma_XX, Sigma_YY, Sigma_XY)
  Sigma <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2

  if (make_pd && exists("is_pos_def") && exists("make_pos_def")) {
    if (!is_pos_def(Sigma)) Sigma <- make_pos_def(Sigma, eps = eps)
  }

  out <- list(
    Sigma = Sigma,
    Sigma_XX = Sigma_XX,
    Sigma_YY = Sigma_YY,
    Sigma_XY = Sigma_XY,

    U_true = U_true,
    V_true = V_true,
    W_X_true = W_X,
    W_Y_true = W_Y,

    S_true = S,
    r_true = r_vec,
    r = r,
    p_x = p_x,
    p_y = p_y,

    details_X = weights$details_X,
    details_Y = weights$details_Y,
    tries_X = weights$details_X$tries,
    tries_Y = weights$details_Y$tries
  )

  # convenience aliases for r = 3
  if (r >= 1) {
    out$wX_1_true <- W_X[, 1]
    out$wY_1_true <- W_Y[, 1]
  }
  if (r >= 2) {
    out$wX_2_true <- W_X[, 2]
    out$wY_2_true <- W_Y[, 2]
  }
  if (r >= 3) {
    out$wX_3_true <- W_X[, 3]
    out$wY_3_true <- W_Y[, 3]
  }

  out
}
```

### Draw sample and sample CCA

```{r}
# Hybrid draw of sample covariance: Wishart when df >= d, else explicit sampling
draw_sample_cov_hybrid <- function(Sigma, n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  d <- ncol(Sigma)
  n <- max(as.integer(n), 3)

  if ((n - 1) >= d) {
    W <- stats::rWishart(1, df = n - 1, Sigma = Sigma)[,,1]
    return(W / (n - 1))
  }

  Sig <- (Sigma + t(Sigma)) / 2
  R <- chol(Sig + 1e-12 * diag(d))
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(n * d), nrow = n, ncol = d)
  X <- scale(Z %*% R, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  crossprod(X) / (n - 1)
}

# Multivariate CCA from sample covariance blocks
cca_from_sample_cov <- function(Sxx, Syy, Sxy, r = 3, ridge = 1e-10) {
  Sxx <- (Sxx + t(Sxx)) / 2 + diag(ridge, nrow(Sxx))
  Syy <- (Syy + t(Syy)) / 2 + diag(ridge, nrow(Syy))

  p_x <- nrow(Sxx)
  p_y <- nrow(Syy)
  r <- min(as.integer(r), p_x, p_y)
  if (r < 1) stop("r must be at least 1.")

  invsqrt_x <- mat_sqrt_spd(Sxx, inverse = TRUE)
  invsqrt_y <- mat_sqrt_spd(Syy, inverse = TRUE)

  M <- invsqrt_x %*% Sxy %*% invsqrt_y
  sv <- svd(M)

  U_hat <- sv$u[, seq_len(r), drop = FALSE]
  V_hat <- sv$v[, seq_len(r), drop = FALSE]
  W_X_hat <- invsqrt_x %*% U_hat
  W_Y_hat <- invsqrt_y %*% V_hat
  r_hat <- pmin(pmax(sv$d[seq_len(r)], 0), 1)

  list(
    r_hat = as.numeric(r_hat),
    U_hat = U_hat,
    V_hat = V_hat,
    W_X_hat = W_X_hat,
    wX_1_hat = as.numeric(W_X_hat[, 1]),
    wX_2_hat = as.numeric(W_X_hat[, 2]),
    wX_3_hat = as.numeric(W_X_hat[, 3]),
    W_Y_hat = W_Y_hat,
    wY_1_hat = as.numeric(W_Y_hat[, 1]),
    wY_2_hat = as.numeric(W_Y_hat[, 2]),
    wY_3_hat = as.numeric(W_Y_hat[, 3]),
    M = M,
    r_hat = r_hat
  )
}

normalize_eq10 <- function(tilde_w, sigma) {
  denom2 <- quad_form_diag(tilde_w, sigma)  # tilde_w^T Sigma tilde_w
  if (denom2 <= 0) stop("Non-positive quadratic form; sigma must be > 0.")
  tilde_w / sqrt(denom2)
}

align_sign <- function(w_hat, w_true) {
  s <- sign(sum(w_hat * w_true))
  if (s == 0) s <- 1
  s * w_hat
}
```

### Weight stability, Cosine similarity, and PC1

```{r}
if (!exists("cos_sim")) {
  cos_sim <- function(a, b) {
    a <- as.numeric(a); b <- as.numeric(b)
    sum(a*b) / (sqrt(sum(a^2))*sqrt(sum(b^2)) + 1e-12)
  }
}

# E|cos(u, e1)| for random unit u in R^p
expected_abs_cos_random <- function(p) {
  if (p <= 1) return(1)
  2/(p - 1) * exp(lgamma(p/2) - 0.5*log(pi) - lgamma((p - 1)/2))
}

pc1_from_cov <- function(Sxx) {
  eg <- eigen(Sxx, symmetric = TRUE)
  v <- eg$vectors[, 1]
  as.numeric(v / sqrt(sum(v^2)))
}

stability_from_xy_weight_matrices <- function(WX, WY) {
  WX <- sweep(WX, 2, sqrt(colSums(WX^2)), "/")
  WY <- sweep(WY, 2, sqrt(colSums(WY^2)), "/")
  
  GX <- abs(crossprod(WX))
  GY <- abs(crossprod(WY))
  
  idx <- upper.tri(GX)
  mean(pmin(GX[idx], GY[idx]))
}
```

## Figure 4 (a)

### Loop over spf values

```{r}
# Set parameter values
spf_vec <- c(4, 64, 1024)
c_xx <- 1
c_yy <- 1
a_xx <- -1
a_yy <- -1
p_x <- 100
p_y <- 100
r_true <- c(0.7, 0.5, 0.3)
factor <- 1/2
seed_pop <- 1008913972

# Create population object
pop <- make_population_cca(
  c_xx = c_xx,
  c_yy = c_yy,
  a_xx = a_xx,
  a_yy = a_yy,
  p_x = p_x,
  p_y = p_y,
  r_true = r_true,
  seed = seed_pop
)

# Total dimension
p_total <- p_x + p_y

# Empty list to store results
out1 <- vector("list", length(spf_vec))
out2 <- vector("list", length(spf_vec))
out3 <- vector("list", length(spf_vec))

# Loop over samples-per-feature values
for (i in seq_along(spf_vec)) {
  
  spf <- spf_vec[i]
  n <- as.integer(round(spf * p_total))
  
  # Draw sample covariance
  S <- draw_sample_cov_hybrid(pop$Sigma, n = n, seed = seed_pop + spf)
  
  # Extract covariance blocks
  Sxx <- S[1:p_x, 1:p_x]
  Syy <- S[(p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y), (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y)]
  Sxy <- S[1:p_x, (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y)]
  
  fit <- cca_from_sample_cov(Sxx, Syy, Sxy, r = 3)
  #fit_aligned <- align_cca_fit_repeated(fit, pop, ref = "u")
  wX_1_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 1], pop$Sigma_XX)
  wX_1_hat <- align_sign(wX_1_hat, pop$wX_1_true)
  wX_2_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 2], pop$Sigma_XX)
  wX_2_hat <- align_sign(wX_2_hat, pop$wX_2_true)
  wX_3_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 3], pop$Sigma_XX)
  wX_3_hat <- align_sign(wX_3_hat, pop$wX_3_true)
  
  out1[[i]] <- data.frame(
    pc = 1:p_x,
    diff = wX_1_hat - pop$wX_1_true,
    samples_per_feature = factor(spf, levels = spf_vec)
  )
  out2[[i]] <- data.frame(
    pc = 1:p_x,
    diff = wX_2_hat - pop$wX_2_true,
    samples_per_feature = factor(spf, levels = spf_vec)
  )
  out3[[i]] <- data.frame(
    pc = 1:p_x,
    diff = wX_3_hat - pop$wX_3_true,
    samples_per_feature = factor(spf, levels = spf_vec)
  )
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
df4a1 <- do.call(rbind, out1)
df4a2 <- do.call(rbind, out2)
df4a3 <- do.call(rbind, out3)
```

```{r}
        pop$Sigma,
        n = n,
        seed = seed + 1e6 * cov_id + 1000 * spf + rep_id
      )

      Sxx <- Shat[1:p_x, 1:p_x, drop = FALSE]
      Syy <- Shat[(p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y), (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y), drop = FALSE]
      Sxy <- Shat[1:p_x, (p_x + 1):(p_x + p_y), drop = FALSE]

      fit <- cca_from_sample_cov(Sxx, Syy, Sxy, r = n_mode, ridge = ridge)
      
      wX_1_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 1], pop$Sigma_XX)
      wX_1_hat <- align_sign(wX_1_hat, pop$wX_1_true)
      wX_2_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 2], pop$Sigma_XX)
      wX_2_hat <- align_sign(wX_2_hat, pop$wX_2_true)
      wX_3_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 3], pop$Sigma_XX)
      wX_3_hat <- align_sign(wX_3_hat, pop$wX_3_true)
      wY_1_hat <- normalize_eq10(wY_1_hat, pop$Sigma_YY)
      wY_1_hat <- align_sign(wY_1_hat, pop$wY_1_true)
      wY_2_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_Y_hat[, 2], pop$Sigma_YY)
      wY_2_hat <- align_sign(wY_2_hat, pop$wY_2_true)
      wY_3_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_Y_hat[, 3], pop$Sigma_YY)
      wY_3_hat <- align_sign(wY_3_hat, pop$wY_3_true)

      WX1[, rep_id] <- wX_1_hat
      WX2[, rep_id] <- wX_2_hat
      WX3[, rep_id] <- wX_3_hat
      WY1[, rep_id] <- wY_1_hat
      WY2[, rep_id] <- wY_2_hat
      WY3[, rep_id] <- wY_3_hat
    }

    stab1 <- stability_from_xy_weight_matrices(WX1, WY1)
    stab2 <- stability_from_xy_weight_matrices(WX2, WY2)
    stab3 <- stability_from_xy_weight_matrices(WX3, WY3)

    out1[[k]] <- data.frame(
      cov_id = cov_id,
      samples_per_feature = spf,
      stability = stab1
    )
    out2[[k]] <- data.frame(
      cov_id = cov_id,
      samples_per_feature = spf,
      stability = stab2
    )
    out3[[k]] <- data.frame(
      cov_id = cov_id,
      samples_per_feature = spf,
      stability = stab3
    )
    k <- k + 1
  }
}

df1 <- do.call(rbind, out1)
df2 <- do.call(rbind, out2)
df3 <- do.call(rbind, out3)

df_avg1 <- aggregate(stability ~ samples_per_feature, data = df1, FUN = mean)
df_avg1$cov_id <- "avg"
df_avg2 <- aggregate(stability ~ samples_per_feature, data = df2, FUN = mean)
df_avg2$cov_id <- "avg"
df_avg3 <- aggregate(stability ~ samples_per_feature, data = df3, FUN = mean)
df_avg3$cov_id <- "avg"
```

## Figure 4 (e)

### Low r loop

```{r}
r_true_vec <- c(0.3, 0.2, 0.1)
r <- length(r_true_vec)

p_vals <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64)
spf_grid <- seq(5, 200, by = 5)

n_cov <- 5
n_draw <- 50
ridge <- 1e-10
seed <- 1008913972

rows1 <- list()
k <- 1
```

```{r}
for (p in p_vals) {

  baseline <- expected_abs_cos_random(p)

  for (cov_id in seq_len(n_cov)) {

    pop <- make_population_cca(
      p_x = p,
      p_y = p,
      r = r,
      r_true = r_true_vec,
      seed = seed + 10000 * cov_id + 17 * p
    )

    for (spf in spf_grid) {
      n <- as.integer(round(spf * (p + p)))

      vals_mat1 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_draw, ncol = r)

      for (b in seq_len(n_draw)) {
        Shat <- draw_sample_cov_hybrid(
          pop$Sigma,
          n = n,
          seed = seed + 1e6 * cov_id + 1000 * spf + b + 99 * p
        )

        Sxx <- Shat[1:p, 1:p, drop = FALSE]
        Syy <- Shat[(p + 1):(2 * p), (p + 1):(2 * p), drop = FALSE]
        Sxy <- Shat[1:p, (p + 1):(2 * p), drop = FALSE]

        fit <- cca_from_sample_cov(
          Sxx = Sxx,
          Syy = Syy,
          Sxy = Sxy,
          r = r,
          ridge = ridge
        )

        wX_1_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 1], pop$Sigma_XX)
        wX_1_hat <- align_sign(wX_1_hat, pop$wX_1_true)

        wX_2_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 2], pop$Sigma_XX)
        wX_2_hat <- align_sign(wX_2_hat, pop$wX_2_true)

        wX_3_hat <- normalize_eq10(fit$W_X_hat[, 3], pop$Sigma_XX)
        wX_3_hat <- align_sign(wX_3_hat, pop$wX_3_true)

        # PC1 of the sample X covariance
        ax <- eigen(Sxx, symmetric = TRUE)$vectors[, 1]

        vals_mat1[b, 1] <- abs(cos_sim(wX_1_hat, ax)) - baseline
        vals_mat1[b, 2] <- abs(cos_sim(wX_2_hat, ax)) - baseline
        vals_mat1[b, 3] <- abs(cos_sim(wX_3_hat, ax)) - baseline
      }

      rows1[[k]] <- data.frame(
        mode = rep(seq_len(r), each = n_draw),
        r_true = rep(r_true_vec, each = n_draw),
        samples_per_feature = spf,
        value = c(vals_mat1[, 1], vals_mat1[, 2], vals_mat1[, 3]),
        p = p,
        cov_id = cov_id
      )
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
}

dfe1 <- do.call(rbind, rows1)
```

### Plot low r

```{r}
df4e1 <- dfe1 %>%
  group_by(mode, r_true, samples_per_feature) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    lo = quantile(value, 0.025),
    hi = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df4e1$label <- factor(
  df4e1$r_true,
  levels = c(0.3, 0.2, 0.1),
  labels = c("r_true = 0.3", "r_true = 0.2", "r_true = 0.1")
)

p4e1 <- ggplot(
  df4e1,
  aes(
    x = samples_per_feature,
    y = mean,
    color = label,
    fill = label
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Samples per feature",
    y = "Avg. weight PC1 similarity\n(data - random)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p4e1)
```

## Figure 6

### Loop

```{r}
r_true_vals <- c(0.0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5)
p_vals <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64)
spf_grid <- seq(1, 60, by = 1)

n_cov <- 5
n_draw <- 50
ridge <- 1e-10
seed <- 1

rows <- list()
k <- 1
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
for (r_true in r_true_vals) {
  for (p in p_vals) {
    for (cov_id in seq_len(n_cov)) {

      pop <- make_population_cca(
        p_x = p, p_y = p,
        r_true = r_true,
        seed = seed + 10000 * cov_id + 19 * p + round(100 * r_true)
      )

      for (spf in spf_grid) {
        n <- as.integer(round(spf * (p + p)))

        rhat <- numeric(n_draw)
        for (b in seq_len(n_draw)) {
          Shat <- draw_sample_cov_hybrid(
            pop$Sigma, n = n,
            seed = seed + 1e6 * cov_id + 1000 * spf + b + 7 * p
          )
          Sxx <- Shat[1:p, 1:p]
          Syy <- Shat[(p + 1):(p + p), (p + 1):(p + p)]
          Sxy <- Shat[1:p, (p + 1):(p + p)]
          fit <- cca_from_sample_cov(Sxx, Syy, Sxy)
          rhat[b] <- fit$r_hat
        }

        rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
          r_true = r_true,
          samples_per_feature = spf,
          r_hat = rhat
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
}

df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
```

### Plot

```{r}
df6 <- df %>%
  group_by(r_true, samples_per_feature) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(r_hat),
    lo = quantile(r_hat, 0.025),
    hi = quantile(r_hat, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p6 <- ggplot(
  df6,
  aes(
    x = samples_per_feature, y = mean,
    color = factor(r_true), fill = factor(r_true)
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Samples per feature",
    y = "Observed correlation",
    color = "r_true", fill = "r_true"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p6)
```
